required_changes: Repository/package/source preflight. Short ImplementationDesignPreflight maps current transient/canonical/navigation ownership and exact invalidation/retry rules; CLEAR continues in same turn without control ACK.

Use retained costly-path observations first; inspect reset/locality/progress and freeze a causal diagnosis before edits. Add only missing bounded private diagnostic counters and an actual-path failing work/progress test. Existing repeated full body preparation must not be assumed without proof.

Slice2: repair avoidable transient scene replay by reusing validated body/mask/ordered composition or damaged-region results in the existing cache. Avoid activity permanently lifting selected objects over later content. Only redraw affected content when the validity/dependency proof permits.

Slice3: repair canonical excessive replay or redundant per-attempt work. Preserve monotonic job progress and valid results across same-basis retries; localize visible/intersecting component work without changing primitive order/grid. Remove proved redundant scans/validation only with full immutable qualification. Existing deadlines/quotas stay unchanged.

Build exact ordinary candidate, complete frozen primary and immediate outward-navigation comparisons, independent minimal correctness replay/pixels, compact result and new demo; preserve valid prior work and report material residuals.
forbidden_changes: No main merge, commit, push, tag, release, new worktree, reset, stash, gitclean, subagent, automation or extra thread/Worker. This is Render reuse work, not another multi-thread expansion.
No publicSDK/ABI/semantic schema/Operation/Brush/math/f32/exact union representation change. No unsupported-brush Worker or legacy synchronous union migration; no broad Scene stamp rewrite.
No budget/count/time quota/quiet delay increase; no withdrawnCPUW5 quota-loop restoration; no timing holds/fake stable/no-op receipts/skipped source comparisons.

No force CPU fallback, unfinished scratch publish, stale background exposure, premature GPU lease release, preview clearing before matching CanonicalVisible, or changed input/operation/capture order to shorten the measured wait.
No old evidence/hash-boundSDK/userDemo overwrite, dependency source builds or lock changes. Only remove this package-owned duplicate scratch after preserving bindings.

production: runtime/render/ existing renderer/cache/material job/prepared geometry/body/mask/ordered composition/navigation validity/resource retirement owners
runtime/composition/ and runtime/interaction/ existing frame opportunity and pending presentation coordination only if a demonstrated direct dependency of the two Render repairs
sdk/common/session.cpp and sdk/web/ private frame pump only if directly necessary to preserve corrected Render scheduling; no consumer contract change
tests_and_build: verification/runners/g5/ new postworker_render_reuse driver/analysis and focused verification/tests; reuse original input contract unchanged
docs: one narrow new Render repair note
scope.limit: Two related Render slices with ordinary owner dependencies, not the entire UR3/UR4/UR5 matrix. Routine filename/implementation choice is authorized. A verified missing algorithm/scope decision returns to control rather than expanding scope.

oracle_precondition.expected_failure: Current affected Render path performs avoidable work or invalidates useful progress under fixed unchanged basis; independent full reference pixels remain correct.

all_of: Both authorized paths inspected, causal repairs and targeted work/pixel regression completed or precisely evidenced in-scope no-change finding.
Frozen finite ordinary comparisons and semantic/pixel/progress checks complete without unresolved correctness regression.
Reviewable exact result and candidate demo or justified no-overall-improvement terminal. No default Demo replacement or false fix claim.

terminal_blockers.policy: Preserve evidence and valid work; repair routine compile/driver failures within scope. No endless resampling. Slow but finishing and >5s are findings, not authority blockers.

return_policy.notifications: Human explicitly authorized pairing and proactive callbacks. Send this control thread accepted/designCLEAR, meaningful causal/sampling progress, real blockers and final result path+SHA/source+SDK IDs/demo URL. Do not wait for control ACK at CLEAR, RED/GREEN or normal sampling; do not let the two chats wait on each other.
return_policy.materialization: Shared controlled worktree with exact source patch/new files and hashed compact artifacts; no mandatory commit/hosted CI for this package.
